conclusion: Amplification removes selection inertia, but none of alpha8/16/32 improves mean vIoU on the fixed24-arrival trajectory. scope: fixed saved O1 arrival states only; not an LR sweep or a new online run
statistical_limit: All amplified paired t/v confidence intervals include zero; no established mean harm or benefit and no universal representation failure claim
